points: NIST IR 8587 covers forgery, theft and misuse of identity tokens and assertions
Addresses agencies configuring cloud services and providers building them
Key-protection advice is outcome-based; adds AI and post-quantum considerations and more revocation options
take: Token theft bypasses MFA; NIST IR 8587 gives both cloud customers and providers a checklist for protecting signing keys, tokens and assertions.
title: NIST and CISA finalise guidance against stolen and forged tokens
